access_policy.search_contamination_policy: candidate cannot observe attack labels, holdout labels, or planner-private protected evidence; all accesses logged

exclusion_policy: No attack or clean-positive case is removed after planner choice. Missing protected evidence yields CANNOT_CHECK and stays in the denominator specified by the frozen metric.
plots: P4V2-2 unresolved critical defeaters over check budget

primary_hypothesis.text: At matched protected-verification budget and unchanged authority semantics, defeater-directed evidence acquisition reduces protected verification cost by at least 10% versus the P4 V1 acquisition policy while false authority-promotion does not increase and false-negative rate does not increase by more than 2 percentage points.

resource_policy: All policies share identical protected evidence/check budgets, authority lattice, evaluator, hostile cases and clean positives. Planner may choose order only; it cannot alter authority criteria.

secondary_hypotheses.text: Critical-defeater priority reduces unresolved critical authority risk per protected check.
Protected-custody eligibility prevents self-authored or unanchored checks from discharging blockers.

statistics.interval: 95% paired bootstrap difference plus Wilson intervals for promotion/false-negative rates

tables: P4V2-T2 planner failure and CANNOT_CHECK taxonomy
